parameters.name: AiNodes
parameters.description: The list of AI nodes used for model deployment.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The idempotency check. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~327176~~).

parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a region.

parameters.name: EnablePublicConnection
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable public network access.

parameters.name: InferenceEngine
parameters.description: The inference engine. Currently, only vllm is supported.

parameters.name: ModelParams
parameters.description: The model parameters. This parameter is not supported.

parameters.name: Replicas
parameters.description: The number of model service replicas.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs. For information about how to obtain the resource group ID, see [View basic information of a resource group](~~151181~~).

parameters.name: SecurityIPList
parameters.description:
The IP whitelist.

The value 127.0.0.1 indicates that no external IP addresses are allowed to access the instance. After the instance is created, you can call the [ModifySecurityIps](~~86928~~) operation to modify the IP whitelist.
